title: Rectangling a Rectangle
exact_target: Do there exist rectangular partitions into $n\ge2$ pieces of equal area with pairwise different perimeters? The source reports a seven-piece construction with real edge lengths and asks whether such a partition is possible with all edge lengths rational, conjecturing that it is not. The source also asks for the analogous equal-volume, distinct-boundary-measure partition into boxes in $\mathbb R^d$ for $d\ge3$, with a conjectured negative answer.
